# Phase 8 independent commit review

Date: 2026-09-10

This review is bound to the frozen Phase 8 commits and was performed after the
full regression, rather than relying on the focused implementation run. The
workstreams were also checked in separate temporary worktrees with the other
workstream reverted:

| Frozen snapshot | Review action | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `34ecb9c` | 8A tests with 8B reverted | Icarus BIU PASS; Verilator BIU PASS; Verilator CPU XCHG PASS |
| `b86d30e` with `34ecb9c` reverted | 8B tests with 8A reverted | Icarus ESC PASS; Verilator decoder PASS; 88 microcode tests, audit and compile check PASS |
| `b86d30e` | integrated review | `make unit`, `make synth-check` and `make regression` PASS |

## Findings

- 8A changes only the BIU's stale-HLDA release condition. The direct test
  covers arbitration, odd-word locked writes and READY waits; the CPU test
  obtains implicit LOCK from memory `XCHG`, proves two reads/two writes and
  verifies a later legal HOLD grant. No idle/NOP timing state or external
  protocol change was introduced.
- 8B admits the complete D8–DF range through one decoder entry and one
  source-owned terminal microprogram. The directed test covers all eight
  opcodes, register and memory ModR/M forms, displacement widths, a segment
  override, READY waits, exact IP progress and a follow-on instruction. It
  observes no data-operand transaction and no repeated retirement.
- Generated microcode artifacts were regenerated by the project compiler and
  pass the round-trip, source-coupling, audit and compile checks. The generated
  ROM was not hand-edited.
- The SPK286 diff contains CPU RTL, project microcode, CPU-only tests and
  manifests only. No PCAT bus overlay, DMA/DACK signal, XT serializer, MiSTer
  top-level, debug instrumentation or BIOS image was added.
- SingleStep coverage remains the applicable 80286 corpus for existing
  instruction families. D8–DF ESC has no executable 80287 corpus in this
  repository; its complete admitted range is covered by the dedicated
  no-coprocessor profile test instead of by fabricated SingleStep expectations.

## Review disposition

No substantive finding remains in the two Phase 8 workstreams. The inherited
D-037 evidence notes remain open and unchanged. The downstream transfer and
the user-owned Quartus/RBF hardware checkpoint are separate pending steps; no
hardware result is inferred from this review.
